0022600102.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and second in the Pacific, host the 1-0 Clippers, who sit first in the Pacific, in the second game of the Lakers' season. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Lakers won the most recent meeting 125-122 in Los Angeles on February 20, 2026, with no games yet between them in 2026-27.
